The '''Pyramid Decal''' is a [[furniture]] item that hangs on a wall. It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the [[The Desert|Calico Desert]] southern pond (10% chance).<ref name="pyramidchance" /> Multiple decals can be obtained.

[[File:Pyramid Decal Location.png|thumb|left|Location]]
{{clear}}

==Bugs==
The Pyramid Decal may be unobtainable on Nintendo Switch and Xbox.
